from clamp import clamp

def test_inside():
    assert clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5

    assert clamp(11, 0, 10) == 10
    assert clamp(0, 0, 10) == 0
    assert clamp(10, 0, 10) == 10
    assert clamp(7, 3, 3) == 3

tasks.description: Fix unique_order(numbers) for integer lists: remove duplicates, preserve first occurrence, return a new list and leave input unchanged. Preserve signature. Retain import and test_empty. Append only test_order asserting unique_order([3,1,3,2,1])==[3,1,2] then unique_order([-1,0,-1,2,0])==[-1,0,2]. Append test_input assigning values=[5,5,5], result=unique_order(values), then asserting result==[5], values==[5,5,5], result is not values in that order. Change both files.
tasks.expected_test_source:
from unique_order import unique_order

def test_empty():
    assert unique_order([]) == []

def test_order():
    assert unique_order([3, 1, 3, 2, 1]) == [3, 1, 2]
    assert unique_order([-1, 0, -1, 2, 0]) == [-1, 0, 2]

def test_input():
    values = [5, 5, 5]
    result = unique_order(values)
    assert result == [5]
    assert values == [5, 5, 5]
    assert result is not values

functional_profile.instruction: Fix unique_order(numbers) to return each integer once, preserving the order of first appearance. Return a new list and do not mutate the input.
